feature: eNotification SMS/email batch cron (send_ena_reminder) untuk stage ENA dan reminder
note: Mirip OCMS1.6/1.7 (Removed): kirim SMS individu dan email company dari template. Beda: tiap notice individu dapat SMS sendiri, tanpa admin fee di template, scheduler cron.notification.enabled=false. Tidak diklaim.
note_en: Similar to OCMS1.6/1.7 (Removed): sends SMS to individuals and email to companies from templates. Differences: every individual notice gets its own SMS, no admin fee in the template, scheduler cron.notification.enabled=false. Not claimed.

feature: Fallback eNotification gagal / excluded / tanpa kontak ke jalur surat RD1 (retry job + patchNextStageToRd1NextDay)
note: Mirip OCMS1.8 (Removed): notice tanpa jalur elektronik dipindah ke RD1 agar keluar sebagai letter. Pengecekan alamat OCMS8 tidak dipanggil dari sini. Tidak diklaim.
note_en: Similar to OCMS1.8 (Removed): notices without an electronic route are moved to RD1 so they go out as a letter. The OCMS8 address check is not called from here. Not claimed.

feature: Toppan Generate Letters (data file per stage RD1..DR3 + ANL, upload COMCRYPT/SFTP)
note: Mirip OCMS1.9 (Removed): surat post-dated dalam data file ke vendor. Pemanggilan terjadwal dikomentari dan upload Toppan diblokir sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan; tiket OCMS-DF-2026-192. Tidak diklaim.
note_en: Similar to OCMS1.9 (Removed): post-dated letters as a data file to the vendor. The scheduled call is commented out and Toppan upload is blocked by sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan; ticket OCMS-DF-2026-192. Not claimed.

feature: Pergeseran stage ENA ke RD1 setelah masa tunggu STAGEDAYS
note: Mirip OCMS1.10 (Removed): masa tunggu dari parameter lalu notice naik ke RD1. Tidak ada konversi ke NOPO dan masa tunggu mulai saat masuk ENA. Tidak diklaim.
note_en: Similar to OCMS1.10 (Removed): a waiting period from a parameter, then the notice moves to RD1. There is no conversion to a NOPO and the waiting period starts on entering ENA. Not claimed.

feature: Halaman staff eNotification Exclusion List (daftar ID tanpa eNotification)
note: Halaman ENotifExclusion dan tabel ocms_enotification_exclusion_list dipakai cron eNotification (dirujuk di OCMS1.8). Belum dicek apakah ada story di epic lain yang menaunginya.
note_en: The ENotifExclusion page and the ocms_enotification_exclusion_list table are used by the eNotification cron (referenced in OCMS1.8). Not checked whether a story in another epic covers it.
